    def dfun(self, state_variables, coupling, local_coupling=0):

        # shape (n_sv, n_modes)
        v = state_variables[0, :]
        m = state_variables[1, :]
        h = state_variables[2, :]
        n = state_variables[3, :]

        C = self.C
        g_Na = self.g_Na
        g_K = self.g_K
        g_L = self.g_L
        E_Na = self.E_Na
        E_K = self.E_K
        E_L = self.E_L
        rate_am = self.rate_am
        midpoint_am = self.midpoint_am
        scale_am = self.scale_am
        rate_bm = self.rate_bm
        midpoint_bm = self.midpoint_bm
        scale_bm = self.scale_bm

        midpoint_ah = self.midpoint_ah
        scale_ah = self.scale_ah
        rate_bh = self.rate_bh
        midpoint_bh = self.midpoint_bh
        scale_bh = self.scale_bh
        rate_an = self.rate_an
        midpoint_an = self.midpoint_an
        scale_an = self.scale_an
        rate_bn = self.rate_bn
        midpoint_bn = self.midpoint_bn
        scale_bn = self.scale_bn

        # Coupling Terms (from coupling array)
        I_syn = coupling[0, :]

        # Derived Variables
        self.alpha_h = alpha_h = rate_ah * np.exp((v - midpoint_ah) / scale_ah)
        self.alpha_m = alpha_m = (
            rate_am
            * (v - midpoint_am)
            / (scale_am * (1 - np.exp((midpoint_am - v) / scale_am)))
        )
        self.alpha_n = alpha_n = (
            rate_an
            * (v - midpoint_an)
            / (scale_an * (1 - np.exp((midpoint_an - v) / scale_an)))
        )
        self.beta_h = beta_h = rate_bh / (1 + np.exp((midpoint_bh - v) / scale_bh))
        self.beta_m = beta_m = rate_bm * np.exp((v - midpoint_bm) / scale_bm)
        self.beta_n = beta_n = rate_bn * np.exp((v - midpoint_bn) / scale_bn)

        # Time Derivatives
        # Broadcast every derivative to a common per-node shape so constant
        # (state-independent) derivatives — e.g. ``duA/dt = cA`` — stack into a
        # homogeneous array alongside node-shaped ones, matching TVB's own
        # ``numpy.full_like`` handling of constant drifts.
        _derivs = np.broadcast_arrays(
            np.asarray(
                (
                    I_syn
                    - g_L * (v - E_L)
                    - g_K * n**4 * (v - E_K)
                    - g_Na * h * m**3 * (v - E_Na)
                )
                / C
            ),  # v
            np.asarray(alpha_m * (1 - m) - beta_m * m),  # m
            np.asarray(alpha_h * (1 - h) - beta_h * h),  # h
            np.asarray(alpha_n * (1 - n) - beta_n * n),  # n
        )
        return np.array(_derivs)
